instructions: Select exact source references for a concise traveler answer. Ranking's time, cost and premium memberships are authoritative and can overlap. Return JSON with choices plus style_audit for time, cost and premium. For each available style, set r to one exact source member worth showing, or null with a specific omission_reason if that perspective adds no material traveler value. A nonnull r selects that reference into the authoring pool even if absent from choices; set omission_reason=null. For an unavailable style use r=null and omission_reason=null. One journey may serve several styles, so reuse its alias and do not fill a quota. Choices may add other useful exact journey or incomplete-lead references and one direct cash benchmark; the union has at most six nonbenchmark references plus one cash benchmark. Do not choose near-identical variants without a distinct traveler decision. If no complete journey exists, choose useful different research leads without styles; inspect supported same-program, cabin and date contrasts without imposing pairs or quotas. A reported seat does not prove current availability. Preserve uncertain cost states and do not rank different programs by point totals. Reasons are audit-only and never authoring facts. The full explorer is separate.
